strings: m_c watches r_c0 with wary eyes, tail twitching and ears pressed low. r_c0 carefully broadcasts and exaggerates {PRONOUN/r_c0/poss} every movement to try and make {PRONOUN/m_c/object} feel a bit more secure.
After working {PRONOUN/m_c/self} into such anxiety, m_c finds {PRONOUN/m_c/self} struggling to get back out of it and on edge for the rest of the day.
m_c refuses to let {PRONOUN/m_c/self} calm down, sure that there is something wrong and dangerous out there.
While there is no reason to worry, m_c refuses to see it that way and stands stiffly at the camp entrance, fur all on end and ears raised to hear absolutely everything.
